reason: My first question is always if it's really tested, and this one names the lab and puts the batch report behind the QR code, which most brands don't. At $24.99 and with the empty-box refund I'd risk one box, but only one.
objection: Made in China, and I can't tell if the lab report is real until I scan it myself. I already have a drawer full of half-used bottles, so I'm scared I'll quit after a week.
would_change_my_mind: If the QR code didn't open a real report with my batch number, or the price was over $30 for the first box, I'd skip it.
